prompt: Vertical 9:16 candid photo on an old New York subway platform: a silver train smears past, commuters streak by as ghosts, riveted pillars, greenish fluorescent light. Dead centre and perfectly still, facing camera, a figure in a baggy beige thrift-shop suit, trousers too short, a battered tan fedora over a black balaclava, fanning a thick wad of crisp new banknotes, edge-on, microphone at his side. The balaclava has no eye, nose or mouth holes, so no skin shows anywhere; a large white ring is stitched round the whole face, and one small red triangle with rounded corners, pointing down, sits high inside the ring on the right-hand side of the picture. Gloves on both hands; no robot parts. Half-second exposure, 35mm film grain, no text. Thanks.
